decanter-summary.name: Decanter, Sonoma County: The 2022 vintage report, as relayed by a search summary

claims.claim: It was a dry year after several drought years. Spring frost and low water cut the crop.
claims.note: Press Democrat gives the cause as reduced water supplies and spring frosts.

claims.claim: The county crop was 190,864 tons, down 7.3% from 2021.
claims.note: From the county crop report as reported by the Press Democrat. The report itself was not read.

claims.claim: Yields on the coast were lower than the county average. Hirsch in Fort Ross-Seaview reported about half of normal, and Jackson Family in the Petaluma Gap about 30% below typical.
Poor flowering weather caused small berries and tiny yields at Occidental, about one ton per acre.
Harvest started on July 29, a record early start. Russian River Valley finished September 17, its earliest finish in 45 years.
A heat wave began on Labor Day weekend, September 3, and ran about six days. Some sites hit 110 to 115 F, including a Sonoma Coast property.
claims.note: Ridge recorded 115 F on September 5 inland. A search summary says one coast property hit 110 F on Labor Day.

claims.claim: Most Pinot Noir and Chardonnay ripen earlier than Cabernet, so many coastal blocks were picked before the heat or as it arrived.
In the Petaluma Gap, wind kept acidity and tension through the heat. The Pinots show color and spice.
On the Sonoma Coast, cool fermentations and early picks favored finesse over force.
Growers called quality very good. Sonoma County Winegrowers' president called it a stellar vintage.
claims.note: Trade body, so promotional by nature.

claims.claim: Mid-September rain did not hurt quality in Russian River Valley.

conflicts: Rain: Occidental says winter rain helped the vines after 2021, while the county trade body and IWR describe a dry, parched winter.
Heat dates: Ridge puts 115 F on September 5 inland. The coast report says September 3 for six days. They overlap.
gaps: No Petaluma Gap Winegrowers Alliance vintage report found.
No Pinot Noir yield figure for the county.
Decanter's Sonoma 2022 report is paywalled and was not read. Its claims reached us only as a search summary and are not used here.
The Wine Institute harvest report PDF did not load as text.

sheet.vintage: A dry year with a small crop and a record early start. A heat wave hit on Labor Day weekend, but much of the Pinot was picked before or during it. Coastal wines kept their freshness.
